statusLabels.Planned: Reading route only; implementation not yet completed

resourcePolicy.disclosure: Every implementation must state differences from the original paper and report measured local results, including failures.

papers.scope: Short-window forward solve; residual construction; automatic differentiation; a data-only control.

papers.topic: From a known equation to unknown coefficients
papers.scope: 256 observations; joint field/coefficient fitting; clean/noisy/data-only controls; sensor identifiability. Teaching viscosity 0.05, time end 0.5.
Independent 1-D Poisson adaptation of sections 2.3 and 2.5; no reproduction of the 2-D benchmarks or gated architecture.
Independent periodic convection adaptation of sections 3.1 and 5.1. Adam, target beta 10; not the original benchmark or time-window sequence-to-sequence implementation.

Independent harmonic-oscillator ODE adaptation of section 3 residual weighting. Hard initial values, eight bins and a fixed training ceiling; not chaotic/turbulent benchmarks or full Algorithm 1 reproduction.

papers.paper: Yu, Lu, Meng & Karniadakis (2022), Gradient-enhanced physics-informed neural networks for forward and inverse PDE problems
papers.scope: Original 1-D Poisson equation and hard-endpoint ansatz, sections 2.2/3.2.1. Smaller network, 16/32 midpoint sets and 4000 updates; no inverse problem or RAR implementation.

papers.paper: Wu, Zhu, Tan, Kartha & Lu (2023), A comprehensive study of non-adaptive and residual-based adaptive sampling for physics-informed neural networks
papers.scope: Independent stationary1-D advection-diffusion adaptation of sections2.2/2.3.2 RAD. Four fixed32-point policies and512 candidates; not the original six-PDE/ten-method benchmark or RAR-D implementation.

papers.paper: Jagtap, Kharazmi & Karniadakis (2020), Conservative physics-informed neural networks on discrete domains for conservation laws: Applications to forward and inverse problems
papers.scope: Independent two-material steady-conduction adaptation of cPINN state/flux coupling; four interface ablations, not original nonlinear benchmarks, XPINNs or parallel speedup.

papers.topic: Weak-form residuals, test spaces and quadrature
papers.scope: Independent smooth1D heated-rod adaptation of VPINN equations4.7,4.20 and4.25; hard endpoints,Gauss-Legendre quadrature and321-parameter tanh;not original steep-layer/2D benchmarks or hp-VPINNs.

papers.paper: Sukumar & Srivastava, Exact imposition of boundary conditions with distance functions
papers.scope: Independent unit-disk Poisson/Dirichlet teaching adaptation using circular ADF equation7 and a known nonzero lift;not original multidomain,R-function assembly,Neumann,Robin,biharmonic or4D benchmarks. Raw exact-distance control is intentionally non-C1 at centre and cannot define a classical strong residual there.

papers.paper: Wang, Yu & Perdikaris, When and why PINNs fail to train: A neural tangent kernel perspective
papers.topic: NTK, eigenvalues and competing convergence rates
papers.scope: Independent small Poisson rod adaptation: empirical finite-width NTK with mean-normalised output blocks; single hidden layer width32, not original width100/500 or wave benchmarks. Fixed-step SGD with an initial empirical spectral heuristic is not a global stability guarantee or infinite-width convergence proof.

papers.paper: Wang, Wang & Perdikaris, On the eigenvector bias of Fourier feature networks
papers.scope: Teaching adaptation: signed steady rod, two-scale source, tiny shared-core branches; not the original high-frequency benchmarks or a constant-kernel theorem.

papers.paper: Moseley, Markham & Nissen-Meyer, Finite Basis Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.topic: Overlapping subdomains and local multiscale representations
papers.scope: Compact teaching adaptation: four C2 polynomial windows, hard zero endpoints and joint global optimisation. Not the original sigmoid windows, detached-neighbour parallel algorithm or scheduling benchmarks.

papers.topic: Bayesian uncertainty and noisy inverse problems
papers.scope: Planned tiny-network posterior experiment;sampling cost and diagnostics must be validated before implementation.

papers.paper: Raissi, Yazdani & Karniadakis, Hidden fluid mechanics
papers.topic: Infer hidden flow quantities from observations
papers.scope: Planned simplified2D transport example;identifiability and CPU budget to be verified,not original high-resolution or3D reproductions.

papers.paper: Lu et al., Physics-informed neural networks with hard constraints for inverse design
papers.scope: Planned low-dimensional design adaptation;not original large topology optimisation benchmarks.

selectionPolicy: Editorial teaching route,not an exhaustive survey or citation ranking;core mechanisms plus representative applications,each with CPU-budget validation and explicit benchmark departures.
